INNER HEAD. [3] [Eucal.]
Nervous headache and other pains of head, which are not exactly periodic.
Headache in anemic persons ; relieves the pain and causes sleep.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Eucal.]
Catarrhal and gonorrhœal ophthalmia.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Eucal.]
Chronic catarrh of nasal passages, even when purulent and fetid.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Eucal.]
Excessive secretion of saliva.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Eucal.]
Difficult and painful digestion.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Eucal.]
Sharp, aching pains in lower part of bowels, with thin, watery yellow diarrhœa, on rising in morning.
Chronic diarrhœa, mucous and bloody.
Dysentery, with heat in rectum, tenesmus, discharge of mucus, great prostration ; hemorrhage from bowels.
Typhoid diarrhœa and dysentery.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Eucal.]
Vesical catarrh.
Suppressed urine.
Severe pain on urinating ; burning and tenesmus, with fever ; urine loaded with mucus.
Spasmodic stricture of urethra.
Diuresis, nocturnal and diurnal.
Incontinence of urine.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Eucal.]
Recent cases of syphilitic chancres.
Gonorrhœa syphilitica.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Eucal.]
Vascular tumors of the urethra.
Ulcer around orifice of female urethra.
Leucorrhœa, of acrid, fetid mucus.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Eucal.]
Bronchitis in old and feeble persons.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Eucal.]
Asthma humidum in bronchitic patients ; relieves bronchial cough, and aids in expelling thick sputa.
Cardiac asthma ; allays the terrible dyspnœa.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Eucal.]
Strong beating of abdominal aorta synchronous with beating of heart.
Aneurisms involving pressure on vagus and its branches.
   

FEVER. [40] [Eucal.]
Intermittent fever, quotidian tertian and double tertian.
Typhoid fevers.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Eucal.]
Remittent fevers and ague.
Fistulous ulcers, discharging ichorous matter, of a fetid odor ; wounds and ulcers of a putrid septic character.
   

SKIN. [46] [Eucal.]
Ulcers from a varix, of a year's duration.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Eucal.]
Quinine cachexia.
